gallery.description:
University of Ballarat, Camp Street Campus 'New North' Building.
en:Category:Images of Ballarat

This is a photo of part of the University of Ballarat's Camp Street Campus. It is known as the 'New North' building, housing the Graphic Design / Multimedia and Painting studios, as well as residential units on the top floor and a carpark in the basement.

gallery.filename: Doudiet Swearing allegiance to the Southern Cross.jpg
gallery.title: File:Doudiet Swearing allegiance to the Southern Cross.jpg
gallery.description: The Swearing of Allegiance to the Southern Cross (Eureka Flag) at Bakery Hill on 1st December 1854. The watercolour, along with others of Melbourne and the goldfields, was only discovered in 1996 when they were put up for auction at Christies, and subsequently bought by the Ballarat Fine Art Gallery. The painting provided the final authentication of the design of the original Eureka Flag.
